name: blurb-mcp
description: Blurb (RPI Print) (ecommerce suppliers): me, create_order, get_order. Every tool maps to a documente

platform_mcp_blurb_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BLURB_API_KEY
platform_mcp_blurb_api_key.description: RPI Print (Blurb Self-Service) API Key from the Print API Dashboard > API Credentials; the HTTP Basic username.

platform_mcp_blurb_shared_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BLURB_SHARED_SECRET
platform_mcp_blurb_shared_secret.description: RPI Print Shared Secret from the same dashboard page; the HTTP Basic password.

tools.name: me
tools.description: RPI has no account endpoint; the probe lists the client's orders (GET /orders?limit=10, the documented minimum) -> {totalCount, offset, limit, nextOffset, orders[]}. The OpenAPI file behind the reference page is https://docs.api.rpiprint.com/OAS3/public-api-OAS3.yaml.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: POST /orders/create queues a real print order (201 -> {customerOrderId, statusCode, statusDescription}); it is charged once validated (orders wait in the Holding Bin and can be cancelled with DELETE /orders/{customerOrderId}, not mapped). `currency` is always USD (the only documented value). `shipping_address` is RPI's destination {name, address1, address2, city, postal, country (ISO-2), regionCode or state, phone, email}; `items` are orderItems [{sku, quantity, retailPrice, itemDescription, product{coverUrl, gutsUrl}}] with press-ready PDFs; `shipping_option` is the required shippingClassification (standard, expedited, rush, express, priority, economy). Self-service tier: US destinations, 50 orders per 24 h.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /orders/{customerOrderId}: {order{customerOrderId, status, shippingClassification, destination, orderItems}, pricing{orderTotal, itemsTotal, taxesTotal, shippingTotal, currency}, shipmentTracking[{trackingNumber, shipMethod, shipDate}], selectedShipping, validations[], paymentInfo{paymentStatus}}; status is QUEUED, RECEIVED, VALIDATING, VALID_HOLDING_BIN, PRINTING, SHIPPED, CANCELLED, ...
